title: Log what learners did, not inferences
statement: Log what learners did as raw events and compute any model's reading of them later, so the record doesn't change when the model does.
detail: The reading project's item-level telemetry schema was written before any pilot, so that outcome data would exist from the first day, and it stores no inference fields such as predicted mastery, a risk score or an engagement index, which are analysis on top of the raw events (`grade3-reading/artifacts/cert-layer/TELEMETRY-SCHEMA-v0-2026-08-31.md`). Its reason is that a model's opinion baked into the log would make the log disagree with itself the day the model changes, while an append-only raw log never has to be collected again when the analysis improves (the same file).
against: The schema is a design only, and nothing in the app imports it yet (`grade3-reading/artifacts/cert-layer/TELEMETRY-SCHEMA-v0-2026-08-31.md`).
